ShortDescription.Value: Export the current city with Carto and explore it in your browser.

Publish.LongDescription:
SKYLENS MAPS exports the loaded city through Carto and opens a local map in your default browser at ONE CLICK. Search buildings, roads, POIs and routes; view water and transit layers; estimate driving and transit routes. No Node.js, external map service or API key is required.
Install and enable Carto (Paradox Mods 87428) alongside this mod. Load a city, then choose Options > SKYLENS MAPS > Main > LAUNCH SKYLENS MAPS. The first export may pause the game while Carto runs. Reopen map uses the last export for the loaded city.
한국어: Carto와 이 모드를 활성화하고 도시를 불러온 뒤 옵션 > SKYLENS MAPS > Main > LAUNCH SKYLENS MAPS를 누르세요. 기본 브라우저에서 검색, 수역·대중교통 표시, 차량·대중교통 예상 경로를 볼 수 있습니다.
Route times, stops and transit connections are estimates from exported data, not live game routing. The map is available while the game and mod are running. For limitations, logs and issue reporting, see RELEASE_NOTES.md in the mod package.
